description: User-submitted public-services consultation request (healthcare / welfare / education / housing / employment / etc). Originally `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.submitConsult` insertion into `vertex_gov_consult`. Per ADR-2605212100 the etzhayyim-side Kysely write is replaced by MST PUT via `@etzhayyim/sdk`. The record represents the request only; the agent response (LLM triage / referral / eligibility assessment) lives in a separate `com.etzhayyim.gov.consultResponse` record (not yet authored).

requesterDid.description: DID of the requester. Required even for anonymous requests (use a generated did:key for single-use sessions).

category.description: Domain-specific sub-category. Free-form, lowercase, hyphenated. Examples: 'symptom-triage', 'eligibility-childcare-allowance', 'highcost-medical-calc'.

query.description: Free-form user question or request. May be in any language; the response agent is responsible for language detection.

municipalityCode.description: Optional municipality code (e.g. JIS X 0402 6-digit code for JP, FIPS code for US, NUTS code for EU). Resolves to a `com.etzhayyim.gov.municipality` record.

priority.description: Triage priority. Default 'normal'. 'urgent' may trigger faster routing.

status.description: Current consult status. Default 'open' on creation.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC with Z).
